
| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `onBankItemAdded(Item item)` | A new item is added |
| `onBankItemChanged(Item incoming, Item existing)` | Item changed is when the item that is changing is the same ID but different stack sizes |
| `onBankItemRemoved(Item item)` | An Item is removed |
| `onBankItemSwapped(Item incoming, Item outgoing)` | An item is being swapped out with another item |
| `onEquipmentItemAdded(Item item)` | A new item is added |
| `onEquipmentItemChanged(Item incoming, Item existing)` | Item changed is when the item that is changing is the same ID but different stack sizes |
| `onEquipmentItemRemoved(Item item)` | An Item is removed |
| `onEquipmentItemSwapped(Item incoming, Item outgoing)` | An item is being swapped out with another item |
| `onInventoryItemAdded(Item item)` | A new item is added |
| `onInventoryItemChanged(Item incoming, Item existing)` | Item changed is when the item that is changing is the same ID but different stack sizes |
| `onInventoryItemRemoved(Item item)` | An Item is removed |
| `onInventoryItemSwapped(Item incoming, Item outgoing)` | An item is being swapped out with another item |
| `onLootBagItemAdded(Item item)` | An item is being added to the looting bag interface Only gets fired when you check/view looting bag |

### ProjectileListener

**Package:** `org.dreambot.api.script.listener`  
**Type:** interface  

**Methods:**
```java
default void onTargeted(Projectile projectile, Tile target);
default void postTargeted(Projectile projectile);
default void preTargeted(Projectile projectile);
```

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `onTargeted(Projectile projectile, Tile target)` | Deprecated. see preTargeted(Projectile) |
| `postTargeted(Projectile projectile)` | This method is called every frame after the target method is run, this is post-tile movements Note that the target information is already set in Projectile creation, targeted method updates projectile location and target locations |
| `preTargeted(Projectile projectile)` | This method is called every frame the target method is called, this is pre-tile movements Note that the target information is already set in Projectile creation, targeted method updates projectile location and target locations |
